mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( "content", like_count, p_id, u_id, parent_c_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{content}, 0, #{pId}, #{uId}, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL )
mapper.select:
SELECT
c.c_id, c."content", c.like_count, c.p_id AS "pId", c.u_id AS "uId", c.parent_c_id, c.created_at, p.view_count, g.game_alias FROM comments c JOIN post p ON c.p_id = p.p_id JOIN game_list g ON p.game_id = g.game_id WHERE c.u_id = #{value} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
